messages:
Sara: Quick async status check on Console Observability roadmap — dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention. Can owners/assignees confirm current status and blockers? I'll collect and ping product/infra after answers.

Miguel: Dashboard work: PR #482 merged to staging yesterday, widgets rendering. Product wants a metrics sanity check before prod rollout. ETA: EOD Fri for signoff. Deployed to staging: https://staging.console.redwood/dashboard/feature-obs

Anika: Tracing hooks: instrumentation landed on api-server (PR #490) and web client (PR #491). Still TODO: attach model_id span tag and propagate request_id from edge. Need owner for model tag.

Devon: I can own model_id tagging across runtime. Will open router PR tomorrow to add model_id -> span.tag and update unit tests. Also will coordinate sampling rate change with infra. @Miguel can you confirm the tag name should be model_id (snake_case)?

Miguel: yes model_id is fine. We'll need to update dashboard grouping to use that tag.

Priya: Retention: proposed policy: traces=90d, metrics=365d, raw logs=30d. Finance flagged potential cost bump. Miguel — can you share calc? I have a draft for GDPR retention exceptions.

Miguel: Finance estimate: 90d traces = +8% infra; 365d metrics = +6%; keeping raw logs 30d keeps logging cost flat. Spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/infra/costs/obs-retention-2026 (view only)

observability-bot: automated: canary deploy for dashboard widgets started on staging at 2026-03-15T14:02:00Z :rocket:

Anika: For error-analysis views: I created a prototype in Kibana and a mapping for error.code + model_id. Need a sample dataset and eval prompts to validate triage flows. Who can provide a representative error sample from last 7 days?

Devon: I'll extract a 7-day sample from production traces (sanitized) and drop in the shared bucket by EOD. Path: s3://redwood-obsv/samples/console-errors/7d

Sara: Ok next steps collected:
- Miguel: finalize cost numbers, product signoff for dashboard (ETA Fri EOD)
- Devon: router PR for model_id tagging + sample traces (PR + s3) (ETA Tue)
- Anika: wire span tags in client/server after Devon's PR, finish error view mapping (ETA Wed)
- Priya: finalize retention policy doc & exceptions (ETA Thu)

Sara: Any blockers? If not, I'll loop in product and infra tomorrow morning with this plan.

Miguel: No blockers from my side. :thumbsup:

Priya: No blockers. FYI compliance asked for retention audit logs; I'll add to doc.

Devon: small blocker: older runtime nodes missing the new tracer lib, need infra image roll; I'll open infra ticket and cc @infra-team.

Anika: ack

Sara: thanks all — please update this thread when your item is done so I can close the async sync.
